description: A template outlining metadata to be provided by contributors that is applied as a preliminary set of annotations to Olink dataset files.

dataLevel.description: Level of data processing applied to file. Levels refer to pre-defined standards of processing for the given assay.
dataLevel.title: dataLevel

fileFormat.description: Standard file format name or file extension
fileFormat.title: fileFormat

plateID.description: An identifier, unique within a dataset, used to label a multi-well plate used for sample profiling. For aggregated data files please specify all corresponding plateIDs with a comma-delimited list.
plateID.title: plateID

resourceType.description: High-level classification of the file content
resourceType.title: resourceType

specimenModality.description: Label assigned to experimental data files indicating whether the data contained corresponds to a single or multiple biospecimens
specimenModality.title: specimenModality

title: OlinkFileAnnotationTemplate
